# **Client Carts**

**![Fabric](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mod_Loader-Fabric-beige?style=flat&logo=data:image/svg%2bxml;base64,&label=Mod%20Loader&labelColor=black) ![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/actuallymilk/Client-Carts?style=flat&logo=github&label=Stars&labelColor=black&color=white)**\
*Not Allowed on Sub-Tiers currently (Getting Fixed)*
</div>

Basically it works by spawning a *fake* ghost cart before the server processes you placing it letting higher ping players better visualize xbows and insta carts

Requires:
- [YACL](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl)
- [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)

Allowed on:
- Basically everything

*this is* ***NOT*** *a cheat it is purely visual and meant as a QOL mod*
